oṇa: [ava + namu + eyya] (na) meyya (kri) CL=7 (He) should bend. (A) (He) should bow down. Should be low down. See - Oṇa(na)mati (A). (B) (He) should bow down. (He) should bow down and pay respect. See - Oṇa(na)mati (B).
oṇahana: [ava + dhā + yu] (na) CL=7 Blocks (Viññāṇa, dvāra). See - Ona-hanarasa.
[ava + naha + yu] (na) CL=7 Forming (sampayutta dhammas). See - Onahanarasa.
oṇamanta: [ava + namu + anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is inferior. (2) One who bends down.
oṇamanti: [ata + namu + a + anti] (kri) CL=7 They bow down. (A) They bend down. They fall. See - Oṇa(na)mati (A). (B) They incline or lean. They bend. See - Oṇa (na) mati (C).
oṇametvā: [ava + namu + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having bent down.
oṇamita: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 Having bent down. See below.
oṇamitasākha: [oṇamitā + sākhā] (ti) CL=7 With a bent branch.
oṇamitvā: [ava + namu + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having bent down.
oṇata: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) A low place. A valley. (2) One who is a bent body. 93) One who is with a bent head. (jāta,sya.) (4) One who is inferior. (5) Bowed down, (6) Bow down in a dangling position.
oṇatabhāva: [oṇata + bhā0] (pu) CL=7 As a state of bending down.
oṇatacāpasaṇṭhāna: [oṇatacāpa + saṇṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 The appearance is like a crossbow that is bent.
oṇatasarīra: [oṇata + sarīra] (ti) CL=7 One who is a bent body.
oṇatavinata: [oṇata + vinata] (ti) CL=7 Bow down or bend down. Bow down in a dangling position.
oṇati: [ava + namu + ti] (thī) CL=7 Behaves humbly. Being down-hearted. depression. Decreases pride or lacks pride.
oṇatoṇata: [oṇata + oṇata] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who bows down. (2) (A) One who is inferior, is low in the present life and the next existence. (B) One who is inferior in the present life and the next life.
oṇatuṇthata: [oṇata + uṇthata] (ti) CL=7 (1) A low place. A high place. (2) (A bench or bedstead) that is uneven some place is high and another place is low. (3) One who lacks perfection in the present life and the next existence perfects. (4) One who is inferior in the present life and is noble in the next existence. (5) (The land) that someplace is high and another place is low.
oṇatākāra: [oṇata + ākāra] (ti) CL=7 One who has the manner of bending down.
oṇi: [ava + nī + ta. ] (ṇī)ta 1 (ti) CL=7 [Pārā, gaṃ, saca, 2. 399. Oṇa + ta. Dhātvattha. 36. Nīti, dhā. 60] (1) Has been removed. (B) Being separately. Free from. (3) Makes to be pure.
oṇirakkha: [oṇi + rakkha + a] (ti) CL=7 One who looks after the wealth in a moment, that wealth is brought by others to keep their wealth.
oṇirakkhakathā: [oṇirakkha + kathā] (thi) CL=7 (Words (sound)) that is based on one who looks after the wealth in a moment, that wealth is brought by others to keep their wealth. See - Oṇirakkha.
oṇitta: [ata + namu + ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [Calaṅa, gaṃ.] (1) Being separately. Being free from (something). (2) Makes to be pure.
oṇittapattapāṇi: [oṇitta + patta + pāṇi] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is free from a monk bowl in his hand. (2) With a clean monk bowl from his hand (due to reject āmisa). With a clean hand and monk bowl (due to reject āmisa). (Lord Buddha, etc.,) who washes the hands and monk bowl, puts them someplace, and sits.
oṇittasadda: [oṇitta + sadda] (pu) CL=7 The word - Oṇitta. See - Oṇī(ṇi)tapattapāṇi.
oṇojana: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + yu. ] (na)  CL=7 [Pācita, yo. Calaṅaḥ, gaṃ, 3. 12. Dhātvattha. 213. Avanejana (saṃ).] (1) Giving up. (2) Should be given up alms. See also - Oṇojeti.
oṇojanarasa: [oṇojana + rasa] (ti) CL=7 The function of giving up.
oṇojema: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + ma] (kri) CL=7 I give and give. They poured water and donated it. See Ana Zeti (2).
oṇojemi: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + i] (kri) CL=7 I offer. I offer by pouring water. See - Oṇojeti (2).
oṇojesi: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) = ṇe + ī] (kri) CL=7 He gave. He offered by pouring water. See - Oṇojeti (2).
[ ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I gave. I offered by pouring water. See - Oṇojeti (2).
oṇojesiṃ: [ ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I gave. I offered by pouring water. See - Oṇojeti (2).
oṇojetha: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + tha] (kri) CL=7 May you (pl) give. May you (pl) offer by pouring water. See - Oṇojeti (2).
oṇojeti: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + ti. ] (kā, kri. kri) CL=7 [Avanejayati (saṃ).] (1) He causes to bow down. (2) He gives up. He offers. He donates. He offers (something) by pouring water (symbolically after a meritorious deed).
oṇojetvā: [ava + nuda (ṇuja. Niji) + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having poured water (symbolically after a meritorious deed).
oṇī: [oṇī(ṇi)ta + patta+pāṇi] (ṇi)tapattapāṇi (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is without a monk bow in his hands. (2) One who is free from a monk bowl in his hands. (3) One who has a clean monk bowl in his hand (due to reject āmisa). (sārattha,ṭī.) One who has clean hands and a monk bowl (due to reject āmisa). (sī,ṭī,saca.). (Lord Buddha, etc.,) who washes the hands and monk bowl, puts them someplace, and sits.
